correctness.rationale: The full proof derives an iff total-domination feasibility criterion (at most one base isolate, no selected K2 component), forbids cycles in inclusion-minimal solutions, proves all-covered components are P3, and classifies one-isolate components by every internal edge having a degree-two bud supporting a leaf. The rooted arm species has a single P4 double-count correction. Formal labeled component decompositions prove both all-set and minimal-set generating functions; spectrum and upper-coefficient formulas follow by component counts. A pure standard-library graph-level verifier tested 2,630,165 subsets through order eight, comparing full all-set polynomials through order seven and all possible minimal sets through order eight; integer recurrences checked spectra/upper terms to order 30. No finite computation substitutes for the unrestricted proof.

originality.rationale: The claim is a complete labeled all-size census of total dominating vertex sets and inclusion-minimal total dominating vertex sets in the triangular graphs, plus a necessary-and-sufficient component classification and upper coefficient. The 2012 complete-graph paper gives the already-known scalar minimum only, the 2019 and 2024 papers address optimization algorithms and complexity, and the 2014 work gives general enumeration-complexity reductions. A preceding special-order minimum coefficient, n=3q+1, is explicitly recognized. Actual semantic mathematical-database and literature searches found no equivalent complete census. Publication priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The object is the established total-edge-domination problem on complete graphs, equivalently total domination on the canonical triangular graph family. A known scalar optimum does not describe inclusion-minimal solution distributions. A new full structural forest classification yields exact all-set and minimal-set exponential generating functions, all attainable minimal cardinalities, and explicit upper-size counts. Such distributions are intrinsic to enumerating minimal total edge dominators, not an arbitrarily sliced small instance. The proof gives reusable component/species decompositions. Publication priority remains provisional.
